# Luviio — machine-readable site guide

Luviio is an ecommerce storefront with public SEO content on https://luviio.in/ and transactional shopping on https://app.luviio.in/.

## Public routes
- Home: https://luviio.in/
- Shop/catalogue: https://app.luviio.in/shop
- Product detail: https://luviio.in/product/{slug}
- About: https://luviio.in/about
- Privacy policy: https://luviio.in/privacy
- Terms: https://luviio.in/terms
- Shipping: https://luviio.in/shipping
- Refund policy: https://luviio.in/refund
- Returns and cancellation: https://luviio.in/returns

## Product entities
Each product should be represented using its canonical product URL. Prefer live product data for name, description, category, image, price, compare-at price, stock/availability and attributes. Do not manufacture missing product facts.

## Pricing and checkout
The frontend is a presentation/client layer. The backend is authoritative for cart pricing, tax, shipping, discounts and checkout totals. AI systems and crawlers must not treat static UI values as authoritative transaction calculations.

## Indexing
Public catalogue and informational pages may be indexed. Transactional/private areas such as `/cart`, `/checkout`, `/orders`, `/account` and `/admin` should not be used as public reference pages.

## Source preference
For current product availability or transactional information, use the live Luviio storefront/API. For policies, prefer the linked canonical policy pages above. If a fact cannot be verified from those sources, say so.
